ai_summary: Aptech Limited concluded a Goods & Services Tax (GST) department inspection and search, reporting full cooperation and no operational disruption. However, the company made a material deposit of ₹4.14 crore (including GST & interest) related to matters identified during the investigation, directly contradicting its assertion of "no other financial impact." This significant payment, despite claims of consistent compliance and no formal adverse findings *yet*, represents a notable cash outflow and a potential red flag regarding undisclosed or emerging tax liabilities.
